translations.web: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord, that they don’t argue about words, to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.
translations.bsb: Remind the believers of these things, charging them before God to avoid quarreling over words, which succeeds only in leading the listeners to ruin.
translations.kjv: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive ➔ not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
translations.asv: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them in the sight of the Lord, that they strive not about words, to no profit, to the subverting of them that hear.
